name: RulZ WoW Forever Addons

approval.source: Memory release-every-update (2026-11-06): "Always create a release when pushing an update" (the user asked so the public repo always has a current installer). Memory update-wiki-every-release (2026-11-06): update the wiki whenever an update is pushed. Both start from 'when an update is pushed'; neither authorizes the push itself, so one yes covers the plan.

delivery.commitStyle: Plain sentence naming the addon and its new version, e.g. "Add hunter pet XP tracking to Level Up Tracker 1.2.0".

wiki.rules: Change the pages the update affects: features, commands, buttons, the version examples in Developer-Guide.md; a new addon goes on Home.md and _Sidebar.md. Check that the live pages load after pushing.

notes: Every push to main publishes a release through release.yml: never tag by hand. The installer version comes from package.json, and when that version already has a release CI uses the next patch, so raise package.json only for a bigger jump. Bump an addon's '## Version:' when the addon changes, so the installer offers Update (each addon is a component here; add one per new addon, plus its catalog/addons.json entry). After pushing, confirm the release appeared with the installer .exe attached. The level-up-tracker tag pattern only keeps addon versions from colliding with installer tags; no addon tag is created.
